Abstract: Thep alladium-catalyzed tandem reac-
tions of 2,7-alkadiynylic carbonates with 2,3-allenyl
sulfamidesf or the syntheses of fused tricycles such
as 1,3,6,7,8,9-hexahydrofuro[3,4-h]isoquinoline,
2,3,6,7,8,9-hexahydro-1H-pyrrolo[3,4-h]isoquinoline,
and 2,3,4,7,8,9-hexahydro-1H-cyclopenta[h]isoqui-
noline derivatives have been developed. Am echa-
nism has been proposed based on the isolation of
ab y-product.
Keywords: 2,7-alkadiynylic carbonates;2 ,3-allenyl
sulfamides; palladium;t andem reactions;t ricyclic
isoquinoline derivatives
Isoquinoline derivatives are important structural
motifst hat occur in biologically active alkaloids with
antitumor, antimalarial, or anti-inflammatory activi-
ties.[1] They are also found in aw ide variety of syn-
thetically and functionallyv aluable compoundss uch
as phosphorescent materials,[2] chiral ligands,[3] and
fluorosensors.[4] Therefore,m any efforts have been
made to develop efficient methods for the construc-
tion of isoquinoline skeletons.[5] Nowadays transition
metal-catalyzed cyclization reactions of functionalized
allenes have become very useful methodologies in or-
ganic synthesis.[6] In our previousw ork, the palladi-
um-catalyzed tandem reactions of 2,7-alkadiynylic
carbonates with 2,3-allenoic acids[7] or allenes bearing
ac arbon-center nucleophile[8] to form fused tricyclic
skeletons have been reported (Scheme 1).
We envisioned that the tricyclic nitrogen-containing
heterocycles could be constructed if the 2,3-allenyl
